instruction: Give me 4 comma-separated artist names with the least songs in my Spotify playlists. If the same song is present in multiple playlists, count it once.
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, only knowledge gathering. The playlist and song objects are representatives: at runtime the agent calls show_playlist for every playlist returned by show_playlist_library and show_song for every distinct song id (same song in several playlists counted once), then tallies songs per artist and answers with the 4 least-frequent artists as a comma-separated string. show_playlist carries the discovered song record and show_song carries the answer record as non-API parameters so the aggregate answer becomes (found ...) without quantified conditions. supervisor-complete-task requires (found least-4-artists) and is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on all other actions.
